messages:
maya: heads up — playground embed examples for console/tracing show wrong cost numbers in the preview and one of the previews is throwing a 500. noticed while verifying the kv-cache guide.
sam: ack. can you paste the broken preview link?
maya: https://playground.redwood.ai/examples/console/trace-embed — preview fails with 500. console shows 'payload too large' when generating the preview.
jordan: that rings a bell. we added inline base64 screenshots in that example last week. previews stream the example payload to the render service which has a 1MB limit. also the cost table uses legacy numbers (0.0008/token) which we updated last month.
li: i'll open a tiny PR to swap base64 -> CDN images and update the cost table to current units. who can review quickly?
taylor: i can take a pass. @maya can you run a staging smoke after the change?
maya: yep. proposed changes in the PR: replace inline images with https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/docs/... links, set model: "redwood-alpha-8k" to keep example small, and refresh cost numbers to the new cost-per-token table.
sam: please call out in the PR description which regions and playground preview services this touches (us-west-2, eu-west-1). also add a tiny test that fails if the preview payload > 1MB.
li: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — small, edits across 5 files (examples + quickstart).
docs-bot: PR checks started: lint ✓, link-check ✓, build ✓, embed-preview-smoke ✗ (1 failure)
li: fixing the embed-preview-smoke test — failing because our test embeds a large example for screenshot rendering. switching to a trimmed example in the test.
jordan: while you're at it, can you add a short note to the docs styleguide discouraging base64 screenshots in playground samples? we'll want that as an enforceable guideline.
maya: i'll add a one-paragraph note in docs/style/playground.md (ETA EOD).
li: added test fix and updated cost table. pushed new commit.
taylor: reviewing now. small nit on wording in the cost table, otherwise LGTM.
li: addressed nit, re-ran tests.
docs-bot: All checks passed ✅ (lint, link-check, build, embed-preview-smoke)
taylor: LGTM. @li please merge on green.
li: merged main <- docs/replace-embed-4821 at 3601237918.
deploy-bot: staging deploy triggered for branch docs/replace-embed-4821 (deploy id: dpl-8792).
maya: running staging smoke: preview now renders, no 500s, cost numbers updated. found one minor caption typo in example 3. will open follow-up PR for that.
sam: awesome. please add a changelog bullet in the next docs release notes (0.14.2) mentioning playground preview fixes and updated cost table.
jordan: also created internal scan task SRV-1284 to audit other playground examples for inline assets. assigning to docs backlog.
maya: SRV-1284 created and assigned. i'll include a checklist for scanning: find base64 blobs, check preview size, update model param for examples that don't need the largest model.
taylor: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
